title: feat: add SDK video reference media support
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The SDK’s video options now accept `referenceImages`, `referenceVideos`, and `referenceAudios` as a URL or an array of URLs, encoding arrays with `|` separators. The existing `referenceImage` first/last-frame behavior is unchanged, and the API continues to enforce provider restrictions. The SDK was bumped to `5.1.0-alpha.13`, with its changelog and standalone lockfile updated.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears tiny headphones and helps a CRT monitor robot arrange image, video, and audio cards beside a lime green (#ecf874) video screen, with code-plants growing nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized and shares the frame, never oversized or dominating, strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
